data.name: ShouldIgnoreThePrefixForAlphaPicker
data.value: Ignore "The" prefix for the alpha picker

data.name: DescriptionEnablePagination
data.value: Controls whether library items are split into pages.

data.name: DescriptionItemsPerPage
data.value: The number of library items displayed on each page when pagination is enabled.

data.name: DescriptionShouldIgnoreThePrefixForAlphaPicker
data.value: When enabled, library items whose title begins with "The" are grouped under the first letter of the following word in the alpha picker, e.g. "The Rasmus" is listed under R.

data.name: DescriptionEnableThemeCaching
data.value: Whether the theme files served by the application are cached. Turn this off while editing theme files so the changes appear immediately.

data.name: DescriptionShouldRenderPdfAsImages
data.value: Whether PDF books are rendered as page images, preserving the original layout, but making the text of the pages not selectable or searchable. This is useful for scanned PDFs that have no extractable text.

data.name: DescriptionShouldPreserveBookStyles
data.value: Whether the original styling of book content is preserved when you read a book. Enabling it keeps the look of the book (fonts, colors, alignment), but book styles can load resources from external servers, which those servers could observe; disable it to strip the styles.

data.name: DescriptionShouldAggregateMetadataWhenMissing
data.value: When enabled, the metadata of library items that the first metadata provider does not supply is filled in from the following providers.

data.name: DescriptionShouldAggregateArtworkWhenMissing
data.value: When enabled, the artwork of library items that the first artwork provider does not supply is filled in from the following providers.

data.name: DescriptionShouldKeepDownloadingWhilePaused
data.value: Whether the player keeps downloading the track while playback is paused, up to the entire file, so resuming never waits for data.

data.name: DescriptionShouldAutoplay
data.value: Whether playback continues automatically with the following tracks when an album or artist finishes.

data.name: DescriptionIsGaplessPlaybackEnabled
data.value: Whether consecutive tracks play without a silent gap between them.

data.name: DescriptionReplayGainMode
data.value: How ReplayGain normalization is applied to the tracks you play.

data.name: DescriptionStreamingQuality
data.value: The quality cap applied when the server has to normalize a track for playback. Direct playback is never changed.
